title: Top-level image + selfie tools: rename media to generate_image, cross-referenced descriptions, enumeration carries descriptions
description: Evidence: the operator observes companions misrouting between the selfie tool and the media tool. selfie is already broken out as its own top-level tool (createSelfieTool -> name 'selfie_create', src/primitives/images/tools.ts) rather than a media sub-action, but it still misfires. Root cause in the live enumeration: the surface load_tools maps to (toolset action='list') is createToolsetListPayload in src/core/agent/substrate-agent/adaptive-tools-runtime.ts:413 -- its activeTools/loadedTools entries carry only toolName + source/status and availableExtendedTools is a bare name array, with NO per-tool description; descriptions are only reachable via toolset action='describe' or tool_search. So the companion selecting a tool from the list sees NAME and SOURCE only and picks blind. (The underlying RuntimeToolCatalogEntry in src/core/agent/tool-catalog.ts already carries description; it is simply not surfaced in the list payload. The passive prompt var runtime_extended_tool_names in src/core/agent/substrate-agent/runtime-context-sections/tooling.ts:129 is also names-only.) Both tools are currently registered as 'extended' (src/primitives/images/runtime-wiring.ts:71, registerTool(tool,'extended')) and both conformance entries carry exposure:'extended' (src/core/agent/tool-surface/registry.ts, entries 'media' and 'selfie_create'). Scope: (1) fix the enumeration surface (createToolsetListPayload / the loadable-tool listing) to include a concise per-tool description, token-capped, so the companion never selects blind; (2) rename the generation tool 'media' to 'generate_image' -- no legacy alias (repo no-shims rule), but stored promoted-tool state and skills referencing the old 'media' name must not crash startup, and the old-name load error must state the new name; retire the 'media'->image_create/edit/analyze retired-alias block in registry.ts accordingly. (3) cross-reference the sibling descriptions in BOTH directions (generate_image says 'for images of yourself use selfie'; selfie says 'only self-images; otherwise generate_image' -- see buildImageCreateDescription in tools.ts which already gestures at this one direction), trigger-phrase-rich, each with explicit when-NOT-to-use lines; (4) register both top-level (core) in the default stack, early in list order (flip exposure to 'core' in runtime-wiring.ts and registry.ts). Acceptance: enumeration/list output shows descriptions; selfie and generate_image both resolve as core; conformance registry (src/core/agent/tool-surface/registry.ts) + its tests updated; a naming-boundary test asserts both descriptions cross-reference each other and that the retired 'media' name fails closed with a message naming generate_image.

title: Audit and adjust the default companion top-level tool stack (core vs extended, list order)
description: After img1 (psfn-framework-img1), review every default-registered tool and its exposure tier. Social/expressive tools (selfie, generate_image, future voice) belong core and early in list order; admin/dev/infrequent tools belong extended behind load_tools/promotion (toolset activate/pin). Current tiering lives in CANONICAL_FIRST_PARTY_TOOL_SURFACES (src/core/agent/tool-surface/registry.ts) where each entry declares exposure:'core'|'extended', and in the per-faculty registerTool(tool, scope) calls at composition/runtime-wiring time (e.g. src/primitives/images/runtime-wiring.ts). Deliver a documented default stack with a rationale per tool, applied in composition, plus parity tests so any single-companion behavior change is deliberate (extend the existing composition parity tests, src/app/startup/composition/parity.test.ts). Evidence: operator reports general tool-use confusion consistent with attention dilution (too many peers surfaced at once) and wrong tiering (expressive tools sitting in the extended catalog behind discovery). Depends-on: psfn-framework-img1.

title: Media taxonomy: per-medium generation tools + polymorphic consumption (generate_voice_message, generate_video, analyze_media)
description: Future direction decided 2026-07-09. Generation splits per medium into one verb family -- generate_image (delivered in psfn-framework-img1), generate_voice_message, generate_video -- each with its own params, charge lane (the paidImageGeneration/externalModelConsult charge surfaces in src/primitives/images/tools.ts are the pattern to extend), and capability gating. Consumption is automatic in the inbound pipeline: attachments are described into context, extending the existing image vision-review path (DefaultImageVisionReviewer / getVisionToolRequestContext, src/primitives/images/vision-reviewer.ts and request-context.ts, plus the current-turn vision review fallback in tools.ts) to audio and video. In addition there is exactly ONE deliberate polymorphic tool, analyze_media (takes a reference + a question; medium auto-detected), for deep reads -- replacing the current media action='analyze' path. The bare 'media' tool name is retired permanently (no revival as a catch-all). Each new tool ships with sibling-boundary cross-references in its description (same both-directions rule as img1) as it lands, so the enumeration never presents ambiguous overlapping verbs.
